name: Neo AI
about: Neo AI's own reel-script house style, matched to the team's existing scripts (REEL — STAY UP TO DATE, REEL 03/04 NEXT_START, HERO REEL — Mr. Wael / Sama | COO): A4, Cairo, right-aligned, black headers, blue = for the editor, dark red = what the talent says.

voice.register: Egyptian Arabic with English industry terms kept in English and prefixed with الـ (الـAI، الـbusiness، الـtools). Short lines, a Pause between ideas, 'مش… لكن…' contrasts, direct 'إنت' address.
never: promising results the programme can't prove

Mr. Wael.format: founder-led cinematic statement, English, premium business location, 50mm + gimbal, no glitch, 3–4 main shots
Mr. Wael.wardrobe: dark navy suit or blazer, white / light-blue shirt, no tie

Ms. Sama.format: executive-led, strategic and inclusive, Arabic × English free mix, same premium location as Mr. Wael

Dr. Joshua.role: Head of Development & Research for Innovation / instructor
Dr. Joshua.format: trend & industry commentary, studio, visual hook Joshua → glitch → mascot → glitch → Joshua, FOR EDITOR / FOR TALENT colour legend

Saif.format: energetic, conversational event-value reels, studio medium shot

signatures.trend_reel_hook: SCENE 01 — VISUAL HOOK, 1.2 sec: Talent 0.4 sec → Glitch → Mascot 0.4 sec → Glitch → Talent starts talking. Short digital glitch SFX on each transition only; the rest of the video clean and minimal.
signatures.founder_end_frame: Deep navy background, very subtle orange + white light elements, then the Neo AI logo, then the campaign line and date. Minimal animation — no flashy effects.
signatures.audio_mix: Voice > Music > Environment. Cinematic ambient bed (soft pad, light pulse, slow build), never generic corporate-motivational music.
